ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture begins on Monday, June 15, 2020 and discussion begins on Tuesday, June 16, 2020. Hourly examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00pm: Jul 1, July 15, and July 29, 2020. This section may have one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Final exams are scheduled through Aug. 8, 2020. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
